channel.title: The Meridian Star - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Meridian Star (meridianstar.com)

item.title: Marion aldermen hire lobbying firm to represent town at State Capitol
item.description: The town of Marion will have a larger presence at the State Capitol this year after the Board of Aldermen voted Tuesday to hire a lobbying firm to represent the town’s interests.

item.title: Wicker: proposed ICE facility threatens Byhalia economy and infrastructure
item.description: U.S. Sen. Roger Wicker sent a letter to the Department of Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem on Tuesday expressing opposition to a proposed plan to convert a warehouse in Byhalia into an Immigration and Customs Enforcement detention center.

item.title: Meridian Mardi Gras kicks off Saturday at 11 a.m.
item.description: The streets of Meridian will be decorated with purple, green and gold Saturday as the Arts and Community Events Society hosts its annual Meridian Mardi Gras celebration at City Hall lawn.

item.title: West Lauderdale football sends two to college level
item.description: The West Lauderdale High School football team is sending two of its members to compete at the next level. In a signing ceremony Wednesday, Kohen Peoples and Jaivon Wilson signed […]

item.title: Meridian school board approves emergency repair for burst pipe at Carver Elementary
item.description: The Meridian Public School District Board of Trustees on Wednesday approved an emergency declaration after a water pipe burst in Carver Elementary School needing immediate repair.

item.title: Baseball returns to Meridian High with ribbon cutting for new field
item.description: Meridian High School athletics entered into a new era Wednesday as community leaders and school officials cut the ribbon on a new multipurpose baseball and softball field on the school’s campus.

item.title: Meridian Pet Mayor fundraiser registration now open
item.description: Meridian pet owners are invited to share some photographs of their furry companions for a good cause as Downtown Meridian’s Meridian Pet Mayor fundraiser is open for registration.

item.title: Drug task force search yields one arrest
item.description: A Meridian man is facing criminal charges after the East Mississippi Drug Task Force and Lauderdale County SWAT team on Thursday served a search warrant at a local residence.

item.title: New morning mercies
item.description: “How many times have I made this walk, climbed this hill?” The thought came to mind as I made my way in to hunt Saturday morning. The temperature had bottomed out at 15 degrees just in time for my morning stroll, and the wind, which could best be described as fierce, added to the chill with a “ReelFeel” of -4.

item.title: DABBS cannabis dispensary cuts ribbon on Meridian location
item.description: Meridian officials and business leaders gathered at Dabb’s cannabis dispensary Thursday to cut the ribbon on the dispensary’s new Meridian location on South Frontage Road.
